rules: Only genuine screenshots of a released GPX Viewer build.
Only synthetic or otherwise non-personal GPX files; never a real person's recording or location history.
Keep the map attribution visible; do not crop it away.
Originals go in Setup/public/screenshots/ as PNG; the website builds optimised versions and keeps the aspect ratio.
